_readme: Additional aquatic-species models for BlueEye. Entries whose weights exist on disk are usable immediately; entries without weights are shown honestly as 'not installed', 'needs training' or 'incompatible' - BlueEye never fabricates weights or claims a species is detectable when the model does not support it. Schema and worked examples: models/custom/README.md. Indian roadmap and dataset licences: docs/indian_biodiversity.md.

models.name: Aquatic Fauna (brackish / estuarine)
models.summary: Six-class underwater detector fine-tuned on brackish / estuarine footage.
models.description: crab, fish, jellyfish, shrimp, small_fish, starfish
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + detects). Trained on one Danish brackish camera; not India-specific but relevant to estuaries/backwaters.

models.name: Underwater Fish (grayscale)
models.license: US Government work - not subject to copyright, royalty-free use
models.summary: Single-class fish detector for black-and-white underwater camera footage.
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + runs). Trained on grayscale imagery; may under-detect on colour footage.

models.name: Aquarium & Reef Species
models.summary: Seven-class detector for aquarium / reef footage; includes shark and stingray.
models.description: fish, jellyfish, penguin, puffin, shark, starfish, stingray
models.status_note: Community-contributed: weights load and detect, but no published evaluation metrics.

models.name: Freshwater Fish (India)
models.license: Dataset CC BY 4.0; weights to be trained by us
models.summary: Freshwater pond / river fish for Karnataka and South India.
models.status_note: No trustworthy pretrained Indian freshwater-fish detector was found; train it and register the weights here. Blocker (Oct 2026): the DePondFi files are not served by Mendeley's public API and its 'Download All' is disabled, so the annotations are not yet obtainable.

models.name: Gangetic River Dolphin
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Platanista gangetica surfacing in large Indian rivers.
models.status_note: No public pretrained model exists; the Gangetic dolphin is Endangered and survey imagery must be collected.

models.name: Freshwater Turtle (India)
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Freshwater turtles (roofed, flapshell, softshell) in Indian water bodies.
models.status_note: The MegaFauna model only has a broad 'turtle' class (mostly marine); a freshwater-specific model must be trained.

models.name: Gharial
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Gavialis gangeticus, typically basking on river banks.
models.status_note: No public pretrained gharial detector exists; Chambal / Girwa survey imagery is required.

models.name: Indian Coastal Species
models.source: Dataset: Underwater Species Dataset NR (Mendeley DOI 10.17632/4tp83br92z.1)
models.license: Dataset CC BY 4.0; weights to be trained by us
models.summary: Species-level coastal model for whale shark, octopus, rays and Olive Ridley turtles.
models.status_note: Octopus is not covered by any built-in model; the built-in MegaFauna only covers shark/ray/turtle at group level. Blocker (Oct 2026): the published Mendeley archive (96.7 MB RAR) contains 1,728 images but NO YOLO label files, so it cannot be trained on as-is.

models.name: Aquarium (Axera NPU export)
models.summary: Aquarium detector published only as Axera NPU (.axmodel) files.
models.description: No PyTorch .pt checkpoint is published for this model.
models.status_note: Cannot run here: only Axera NPU (.axmodel) exports are published, not an Ultralytics .pt checkpoint.
